nodes.title: OpenSpec: ui-design-foundation
nodes.description: Execution tracker for openspec/changes/ui-design-foundation. Tailwind v4 @theme tokens, lucide-react icons, shared UI primitives (Button/Dialog/Card/Badge/EmptyState/ErrorState/Tabs/Popover/Icon), palette + date helpers. Additive only — no visual regressions.

nodes.title: 1.1: Install lucide-react, tailwind-merge, @fontsource-variable/inter, @radix-ui/react-dialog, @radix-ui/react-tabs, @radix-ui/react-popover
nodes.description: openspec/changes/ui-design-foundation/tasks.md §1.1. Install `lucide-react`, `tailwind-merge`, `@fontsource-variable/inter`, `@radix-ui/react-dialog`, `@radix-ui/react-tabs`, `@radix-ui/react-popover` with bun.

nodes.title: 1.2: Import Inter variable font in src/main.tsx
nodes.description: openspec/changes/ui-design-foundation/tasks.md §1.2. Import Inter variable font in `src/main.tsx` (`import '@fontsource-variable/inter'`).

nodes.title: 1.3: Verify no App.css import and delete src/App.css
nodes.description: openspec/changes/ui-design-foundation/tasks.md §1.3. Verify no active import of `src/App.css` exists (`grep -r 'App.css' src/`), then delete `src/App.css`.

nodes.title: 2.1: Add @theme block to src/index.css with color tokens
nodes.description: openspec/changes/ui-design-foundation/tasks.md §2.1. Add `@theme { … }` block to `src/index.css` with all surface, border, text, brand, and semantic color tokens (see design.md D1).

nodes.title: 2.2: Add --font-sans token to @theme block
nodes.description: openspec/changes/ui-design-foundation/tasks.md §2.2. Add `--font-sans: 'InterVariable', sans-serif` to the `@theme` block in `src/index.css`.

nodes.title: 2.3: Verify dev server renders Inter with no visual regressions
nodes.description: openspec/changes/ui-design-foundation/tasks.md §2.3. Run `bun run dev` and confirm the app renders with Inter and no visual regressions introduced by the token block.

nodes.title: 3.1: Create src/lib/palettes.ts with STATUS/PRIORITY/RISK/OUTCOME palettes
nodes.description: openspec/changes/ui-design-foundation/tasks.md §3.1. Create `src/lib/palettes.ts` with `STATUS_PALETTE`, `PRIORITY_PALETTE`, `RISK_PALETTE`, `OUTCOME_PALETTE` (Record<string, { bg, text, border }> — all Tailwind class strings).

nodes.title: 3.2: Create src/lib/format/date.ts with formatRelative and formatAbsolute
nodes.description: openspec/changes/ui-design-foundation/tasks.md §3.2. Create `src/lib/format/date.ts` with `formatRelative` (date-fns `formatDistanceToNow`) and `formatAbsolute` (date-fns `format`) helpers; both accept `Date | string | number`.

nodes.title: 3.3: Write unit tests for date formatting helpers
nodes.description: openspec/changes/ui-design-foundation/tasks.md §3.3. Write unit tests in `src/lib/format/__tests__/date.test.ts` covering: relative output, absolute with/without time, ISO string input, numeric timestamp input.

nodes.title: 4.1: Create src/components/ui/Icon.tsx wrapping lucide-react
nodes.description: openspec/changes/ui-design-foundation/tasks.md §4.1. Create `src/components/ui/Icon.tsx` wrapping lucide-react with `name`, `size` (`sm`/`md`/`lg` → 14/16/20px), `strokeWidth` (default 1.5), forwarded `className`.

nodes.title: 5.1: Create Button.tsx with variants and sizes using cn() helper
nodes.description: openspec/changes/ui-design-foundation/tasks.md §5.1. Create `src/components/ui/Button.tsx` with variants `primary | secondary | ghost | danger | link` and sizes `xs | sm | md`; use `clsx` + `tailwind-merge` (`cn()` helper) for class composition.

nodes.title: 5.2: Add leadingIcon, trailingIcon, and loading props to Button
nodes.description: openspec/changes/ui-design-foundation/tasks.md §5.2. Add `leadingIcon`, `trailingIcon`, and `loading` props; `loading` shows spinner (lucide `Loader2`) and disables the button.

nodes.title: 5.3: Add focus-visible ring styles to Button
nodes.description: openspec/changes/ui-design-foundation/tasks.md §5.3. Add `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[--color-accent] focus-visible:ring-offset-1` to all Button states.

nodes.title: 5.4: Write Button smoke tests
nodes.description: openspec/changes/ui-design-foundation/tasks.md §5.4. Write smoke test in `src/components/ui/__tests__/Button.test.tsx`: renders each variant, renders loading state, renders disabled state.

nodes.title: 6.1: Create Dialog.tsx with Radix subcomponents
nodes.description: openspec/changes/ui-design-foundation/tasks.md §6.1. Create `src/components/ui/Dialog.tsx` built on `@radix-ui/react-dialog` with `Dialog.Root`, `Dialog.Trigger`, `Dialog.Header`, `Dialog.Body`, `Dialog.Footer`, `Dialog.Close`.

nodes.title: 6.2: Style Dialog backdrop and content panel with design tokens
nodes.description: openspec/changes/ui-design-foundation/tasks.md §6.2. Style the backdrop as `bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm` and the content panel with `bg-[--color-surface] border border-[--color-border] rounded-xl shadow-2xl`.

nodes.title: 6.3: Write Dialog smoke tests (open, Esc close, backdrop click close)
nodes.description: openspec/changes/ui-design-foundation/tasks.md §6.3. Write smoke test: Dialog opens, Esc closes it, backdrop click closes it.

nodes.title: 7.1: Create Card.tsx with token-based styles and interactive variant
nodes.description: openspec/changes/ui-design-foundation/tasks.md §7.1. Create `src/components/ui/Card.tsx` with base token styles and an optional `interactive` prop that adds hover + focus-visible styles.

nodes.title: 8.1: Create Badge.tsx with semantic variant prop
nodes.description: openspec/changes/ui-design-foundation/tasks.md §8.1. Create `src/components/ui/Badge.tsx` with `variant` prop (`default | success | warning | danger | info | muted`); map variants to tokens from `src/lib/palettes.ts` or direct `--color-*` tokens.

nodes.title: 9.1: Create EmptyState.tsx with icon/title/description/action slots
nodes.description: openspec/changes/ui-design-foundation/tasks.md §9.1. Create `src/components/ui/EmptyState.tsx` with `icon`, `title`, `description?`, `action?` slots; centered layout matching the `ChangesBrowser` empty-state visual style.

nodes.title: 9.2: Create ErrorState.tsx with title/description/retry slots
nodes.description: openspec/changes/ui-design-foundation/tasks.md §9.2. Create `src/components/ui/ErrorState.tsx` with `title`, `description?`, `retry?: () => void`; shows a "Try again" Button when `retry` is provided; never renders raw error strings.

nodes.title: 10.1: Create Tabs.tsx built on @radix-ui/react-tabs
nodes.description: openspec/changes/ui-design-foundation/tasks.md §10.1. Create `src/components/ui/Tabs.tsx` built on `@radix-ui/react-tabs` exposing `Tabs.Root`, `Tabs.List`, `Tabs.Trigger` (blue bottom-border active indicator), `Tabs.Content`.

nodes.title: 10.2: Add focus-visible:ring-2 to Tabs.Trigger
nodes.description: openspec/changes/ui-design-foundation/tasks.md §10.2. Add `focus-visible:ring-2` to `Tabs.Trigger` for keyboard accessibility.

nodes.title: 11.1: Create Popover.tsx built on @radix-ui/react-popover
nodes.description: openspec/changes/ui-design-foundation/tasks.md §11.1. Create `src/components/ui/Popover.tsx` built on `@radix-ui/react-popover` exposing `Popover.Root`, `Popover.Trigger`, `Popover.Content`; content styled with `bg-[--color-surface] border border-[--color-border] rounded-lg shadow-xl`.

nodes.title: 12.1: Run bun run typecheck — zero errors
nodes.description: openspec/changes/ui-design-foundation/tasks.md §12.1. Run `bun run typecheck` — zero errors expected after all primitives are created.

nodes.title: 12.2: Run bun test — all tests pass
nodes.description: openspec/changes/ui-design-foundation/tasks.md §12.2. Run `bun test` — all existing tests pass, new smoke tests pass.

nodes.title: 12.3: Run bun run lint — zero errors
nodes.description: openspec/changes/ui-design-foundation/tasks.md §12.3. Run `bun run lint` — zero lint errors.

nodes.title: 12.4: Run bun run dev and visually walk every view
nodes.description: openspec/changes/ui-design-foundation/tasks.md §12.4. Run `bun run dev`, open BeadSpec, walk every view — confirm zero visual regressions.

nodes.title: 12.5: Run openspec validate ui-design-foundation — passes
nodes.description: openspec/changes/ui-design-foundation/tasks.md §12.5. Run `openspec validate ui-design-foundation` — validation passes.
